contracts.normative_equation_or_contract:
`SC-AOS-CL-C-DOMAIN` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the declared source, trajectory and trapping subjects. No global resource/conductance-box invariance or arbitrary-graph domain theorem is admitted.

All pairings and reference H are unit. The site derivative is
(C-2)^3-(C-2). eta=1/1024, h=tau_A=32, kappa_c=kappa_Ah=1/64,
chi=zeta=kappa_H=1/2, alpha=beta=gamma=1/32768 and W_floor=1/2.
Each parameter that defines A_OS feedback, geometry and the writer is positive.
For incoming C,W, fixed-row descriptors are exact weighted row means in the
GRC9 port chart. With Phi=kappa_c B diag(W) B^T C-site(C)+
kappa_Ah B(H-I)B^T C, j0=-eta diag(W) B^T Phi, the fresh read uses
G=max(1/2,exp(-(C_u+C_v+||D_u-D_v||²+j0_e²)/65536)),
q=(W-G)/(W+G), J=j0/(1-q/4), and f=H^-1(qJ/2).
The predictor uses I; H=I+diag(f) O diag(f)/8, where O=|B|^T|B|.
The corrector recomputes Phi and G at that H on the same C,W.
The OS split bound is strictly below the unchanged 10^-11 tolerance.

Continuity uses the corrector: C+=C-32 B J. The final writer recomputes the
fixed rows at C+ with **incoming W**, and uses that same selected J:
log W+=exp(-1)log W+(1-exp(-1))log G(C+,W,J).
The newly written W never feeds the same beat. The next full read is fresh;
it is reused only on the identical C/logW subject, enforced by the local API.
The floor is proved strictly inactive, closure denominators exceed 3/4, and
O is positive semidefinite, so the generated H is positive definite.

`SC-AOS-CL-C-FULL-TRAP` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the exact charge-21 local C/W return, including every independent W direction.

A joint Newton proposal solves site(C)-B diag(W) B^T C/64=lambda, charge=21,
and log W=log G(C,W,0). Its midpoint iterations only propose an exact rational
center; the center is not treated as a fixed point. The full interval derivative
and strict image margin certify a Banach ball around it, including every
independent resource and conductance direction.

Let W0 be the declared dyadic reference weights, A0=B diag(W0) B^T,
P=(A0+11^T/15)^-1 on the charge tangent. The full norm is
max(sqrt(deltaC^T P deltaC),64||delta logW||_2), with radius 2^-20.
The reference resource derivative is I-A0 D0/32, with
D0=diag(3(C0-2)^2-1)-A0/64. Positive curvature bounds and inverse trace
bound its spectrum in the P metric. The actual derivative is obtained by
analytic differentiation through both reads, generated geometry, fixed-row
ratios, final C and the writer. All four operator blocks are bounded, including
both C/W cross blocks; their row sums give q < **0.998669**. The exact center
defect is below the strict image slack. The local dimension is **14+16=30**.
The rectangular evaluation enclosure is only an outer bound of this full ball.

At a fixed point BJ=0. The physical closure gives J=-D B^T Phi with strictly
positive diagonal D, hence Phi^T B D B^T Phi=0 and J=0. Therefore f=0, H=I,
and the writer identity forces W=G(C,W,0). This proves a self-consistent
stationary writer rather than assuming frozen W. The logarithm is a smooth
coordinate chart on positive W, so no independent W direction is lost.

The complete weighted basin roster over the entire ball, in both port charts,
is p:[p,private] and satellite/2:[n2,n8,satellite/2]. All seed flags, strict
edge orders and anchor barriers are certified. The two charts have identical
ordered incidence **and fixed-row assignments**, which justifies sharing the
physical evolution; chart predicates remain explicitly checked. W stays in
(0.99,1.01), and the graph diameter bound multiplied by 0.99 separates the
nonconstant weighted Laplacian from the 1/64 selector cutoff.

`SC-AOS-CL-C-COMPLETION` is accepted as conditional mathematics for the following declared source, event, lineage, approach and positive-window construction.

The original C-family resource prestates and literal D11 graph are reusable
inputs, not A-family trajectory evidence. A fresh ordinary A_OS source beat
writes C and W; a fresh committed-state read supplies the event. Its complete
qualified parent is p, containing every source node. Saturation, weighted fixed
rows and both strict trigger margins are checked on that actual poststate.
The independent reset state is read without advancing it. Charge is exactly 21
by incidence and rational allocation, never midpoint normalization.

The inherited allocation (1/64,31/32,1/64) did not enter the child trap in either
1536-beat attempt. A diagnostic found the second high-resource site at the
exterior node n2, which is not the required new module anchor. This is a failed
construction, not an impossibility theorem. Two explicit 450-step midpoint
probes tested (1/128,63/64,1/128) and (1/256,127/128,1/256). Both suggested the
child organization. The smaller redistribution was selected and frozen before
fresh interval campaigns. AOSDiscovery.json.xz retains original producer
snapshots, initial declaration/preflight and logs, explicitly as discovery only.
This was not a preregistered search. No probe state feeds the certified runs.

The actual target allocation is **1/128,63/64,1/128**, with zero core and copied
exterior. Every old edge preserves its own incoming conductance through literal
edge lineage; exactly three new internal edges are seeded at W=1. Current
source W starts at 4097/4096; reset W starts independently at 8191/8192.
Allocation alone has only the old qualified basin and earns no gain.

Current **1039 → 1041** completes one new child; independent reset
**1022 → 1024** earns zero live gain. Each positive window spans two
beats (elapsed 64), after full-state entry. Runs took 59.1/
58.5 seconds under fixed one-hour caps and a 1536-beat horizon.
All 2065 C/logW states, both chart
rosters and full read checkpoints are retained. 15,314,456 raw bytes compress
to 1,964,396 bytes. Fixed 8192-bit FLINT/Arb states evolve from exact inputs;
112-bit outward views are used only for storage and inspection. The trap uses
512 bits. No tolerance widening, midpoint evolution or automatic fallback is
used in the certified campaigns.

The retained checker independently rebuilds the source, transfer and trap,
recomputes complete weighted predicates and distances, and checks every saved
transition and read for overlap. Such overlap is consistency evidence, not an
independent second proof of a saved trajectory; the bound producer's outward
recurrence supplies enclosure provenance. Sixteen altered subject/accounting
controls reject. Independent 110-digit equation checks, finite-segment controls
for all thirty tangent directions and writer/OS stage controls support review.
No independent external reviewer is claimed.

This is one declared finite construction and a full local state neighborhood,
not all A_OS graphs, parameters, allocations or source preparations. Mechanism
separation demonstrates the implemented law, not that each mechanism is
necessary for this particular organization. The failed inherited allocation
remains disclosed. Represented/native conservation and lifecycle once-only
accounting remain forward obligations; read-only replay earns no new gain.
